attchmntText: Indo Count Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Indo Count Industries Limited intimates that its officials will attend the Avendus Spark INDX 2026 Conference in Mumbai on 17th November, 2026, starting at 10:00 AM IST. The meetings will include one-on-one and group interactions. The company confirms that discussions will be based solely on publicly available information. No unpublished price-sensitive information is intended to be discussed during these interactions. The company notes that changes to the schedule may occur due to exigencies involving participants, hosts, or the company itself. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Indo Count Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Indo Count Industries Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. The company reported Q2 total income of INR1,699 crores, a 57% year-on-year increase, with EBITDA rising to INR259 crores and margins at 15.3%. H1 FY27 total income stood at INR2,923 crores. New businesses contributed approximately 30% of total income. The Bhilad facility flood claim received an interim insurance payment of INR14 crores 99 lakh. Net debt declined to INR518 crores. The company achieved 53% of its FY27 revenue guidance of INR5,500 crores and expects to exceed full-year targets.
